source_note: Tham chiếu ảnh Unit 1 trang 6–10 do người dùng cung cấp ngày 2026-11-07. Không nhúng ảnh sách. Track 2–6 không được cung cấp; audio luyện tập dùng TTS và ghi nhãn AI.

dialogue.speaker: Vy
dialogue.text: Oh, this is Duy, my new friend.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Hi, Duy. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Duy
dialogue.text: Hi, Phong. I live near here, and we go to the same school.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Good. Hmm, your school bag looks heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Duy
dialogue.text: Yes! I have new books, and we have new subjects to study.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: And a new uniform, Duy! You look smart!

dialogue.speaker: Duy
dialogue.text: Thanks, Phong. We always look smart in our uniforms.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Let me put on my uniform. Then we can go.

true_false.statement: Vy, Phong, and Duy go to the same school.
Phong says Duy looks smart in his uniform.
They have new subjects to study.
Phong is wearing a school uniform.

sound_sentences: My brother has a new compass.
They look smart on their first day at school.
The art lesson starts at nine o'clock.
He goes out to have lunch every Sunday.

interview_prompts: How often do you ride your bicycle to school?
Do you sometimes study in the school library?
Do you like your new school?
Do your friends always go to school with you?
Do you usually do your homework after school?
